scope: First guarded approach on the synthetic roll coupon; stop before any cutter closure. No endpoint qualification at this stage.
short: Use the ordinary v5 full-mode visual setup, both graspers, existing tension/view supervisors, actual cutter alignment and guarded open-jaw forward motion. Intercept the first call to close_scissors before the method body; hold and end this trial with jaws unchanged. Also forbid cutter setGrip below the existing 0.5 rad open command after setup. Cut length and cumulative direct blade-cut count must remain zero; collect all exposures, requests, refusals, guard and reset evidence.
selection: Both cases at the same nonzero roll must reach the intercepted call with both graspers, fresh valid pre-cut front and scissors in that exposure, a positive measured forward move for that approach, valid isolation, no faults/tears/damage, and an open cutter. Both cases must also have a current valid two-bank material chart supporting the 9 mm material knot on at least one in-band, dual-held frame at or after entering ALIGN and before the successful advance; this only demonstrates material visibility, not endpoint detection. Record color counts for all seven material bridges on the first dual-held ALIGN exposure for diagnosis. Require both zero-roll controls to pass as an apparatus check; zero is not an eligible new placement. Choose the passing nonzero angle with smallest magnitude, preferring positive on a tie.
full: Only at the chosen roll start separate nominal and noisy runs from the uncut state, without the interception. Do not alter controller, cuts, camera policy, scene, guards, seeds or renderer. Freeze unchanged bridge-reader predictions before joining the original structural scorer; apply the previously registered paired 8/9 development screen on these new full trajectories, not on the short check. No endpoint reader may drive this stage. Report final structural lengths, reacquisition and closed-ready independently; these are development runs, not five-case M5 acceptance.
